summary: Frontend-only verification of Operations → Equipment UI cleanup on the full DashboardPage and Account Settings → Onboarding. All 6 requested behaviors verified PASS using owner@isodemo.com on the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

tests_executed.details: Equipment tab → Equipment Information Hub: add-equipment-btn=0, ai-import-btn=0, export-csv-btn=0, bulk-download-qr-btn=0. Total Equipment + Warranty cards still render. Equipment list (Life Fitness Treadmill, Precor Elliptical) still visible with Details buttons.

equipment-details-dialog opens. edit-equipment-btn rendered at x=1112, w=119, with ancestor header class 'flex items-start justify-between gap-3 pr-10'. Screenshot confirms Edit Details button is not cramped under the ✕ close button — clear spacing.

lite-equip-log-fault click closes equipment-details-dialog and opens issue-dialog inline; URL stays /dashboard (no ?tab=issues navigation). Serial input prefilled to 'ISO-TM-001' and machine type 'Life Fitness Treadmill' pre-selected.

Account Settings → Onboarding shows 9 step rows (account-onboarding-step-*). All completed steps render blue ✓ tick + normal bold text — no line-through and no opacity-60 on label. Inspected HTML of each step row confirmed has_line_through=False.

ActivationMilestonesCard.js (a separate dashboard widget for First login / First fault logged) still uses 'line-through opacity-60' on fired milestones. This is a different component than the Setup/Onboarding checklist scoped in this request, so technically not a failure — flagging for awareness only.

account-onboarding-step-import_machines → Review opens inline Import equipment panel with toolbar: account-equip-mode-spreadsheet=1, account-equip-mode-invoice=1, account-equip-add-manual=1, account-equip-export-csv=1. Click invoice → account-equip-invoice-wizard visible. Click spreadsheet → Download template + Choose file rendered. Click Add Equipment → add-equipment-dialog-iter224 opens.

Faults tab → expanded PH3-* fault → issue-detail-<id> panel renders with panel background rgb(245,245,247) (light). Supplier Reference card, 'Logged by' card (Sarah Jones, General Manager, Shared Site Login), and Attachments card are all on light surfaces — no dark grey leak observed. Screenshot confirms light theming throughout.
